integrity.method: Analytical rank-one projection identity, Rayleigh-quotient optimization, and uniform ordinary-column bound; standalone exact-rational finite incidence calculations only corroborate.
integrity.proof_scope: Every integer r>=29 and every real positive exceptional conductance; exact supremum and uniquely optimizing conductance for each of two projections.

limitations: Canonical real Euclidean-orthogonal conductance-weighted cut and cycle projections on K_{r,r} for integer r>=29, with one positive conductance varied and ordinary coordinate l1/linfinity norms. Threshold is sufficient, not optimal. Does not optimize over all projections or cover general weighted graphs.
title: Sharp one-edge conductance amplification of the endpoint Hodge norms on \(K_{r,r}\)
